correctness.rationale: The quadratic generator has LV=4-2(x-q)^2-rx^2, coercive for r,g>0, ensuring an invariant law with finite first/second moments and symmetry. Solving the exact reset-free linear SDE after (0,q) yields X_a=b_g(a)q+N(0,v_g(a)), with b_g=g/(g+1)(1-e^{-(1+1/g)a}) and v_g=2a/(g+1)+g²/(g+1)²(1-e^{-2(1+1/g)a}). Independently used symbolic differentiation and the matrix fundamental solution to check its mean and variance formulas, including t=0. Exponential-age conditioning at the last reset with bath preserved, Jensen bound E e^{sbQ}>=1, and v_g>=2a/(g+1) force MGF divergence at and beyond sqrt(r(g+1)). Restricting exponential age to [cz,cz+1] with bounded Q and optimizing rc+(g+1)/(4c) yields the tail lower bound; squeezing establishes zero Gaussian coefficient. The comparator has limiting variance (2r+1)/r and Gaussian quadratic log coefficient r/[2(2r+1)]. No matching finite-g rate or subthreshold MGF finiteness asserted.
